question:
What is the anti Cardiolipin antibody concentration of the female patient with the highest uric acid level in the normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: anti Cardiolipin antibody concentration refers to `aCL IgG`, `aCL IgM`, `aCL IgA`; female patient refers to Sex = F'; highest uric acid level in the normal range refers to MAX(UA > 6.50);

arguments.sql:
